# Tap Native

> Tap Native is a healthcare advertising platform specializing in native advertising, NPI-based physician targeting, and DTC campaigns integrated into medical websites.

Tap Native provides healthcare marketers with precision targeting capabilities across physicians, nurse practitioners, and consumers using proprietary Drug & Condition Match Targeting and NPI data. The platform serves pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, medical publishers, and healthcare advertisers across the US, Canada, UK, and other markets.

## Key Topics

- Native advertising
- NPI targeting
- HCP marketing
- DTC advertising
- Drug & Condition Match Targeting
- Physician targeting
- Healthcare marketing
- Patient acquisition
- Contextual targeting
- Healthcare advertising
- CME content
- HIPAA compliance
- Medical publishers
- Retargeting
- Hospital marketing

## Core Advertising Platforms

- [Tap Native | Healthcare Marketing & Advertising](https://tapnative.com/index.html): Tap Native healthcare advertising platform integrated into medical websites
- [DTC Healthcare Advertising - Tap Native](https://tapnative.com/DTC-Healthcare-Advertising.html): DTC healthcare advertising with Drug and Condition Match Targeting and compliance
- [Healthcare Content Marketing & DTC Advertising to acquire new patients | TapNative.com](https://tapnative.com/reach-consumer.html): DTC advertising platform with Drug & Condition Match Targeting across US, Canada, UK
- [Retargeting | TapNative.com](https://tapnative.com/retargeting-remarketing-advertising.html): Healthcare retargeting and remarketing solution maximizing conversions and ROI

## Healthcare Professional & Physician Marketing

- [HCP Marketing, Physician marketing & NPI Targeting | TapNative.com](https://tapnative.com/hcp-content-marketing.html): HCP targeting platform for physicians, nurse practitioners via NPI-based content
- [Marketing to Physicians & Doctors - Tap Native](https://tapnative.com/marketing-to-physicians.html): Physician marketing solution addressing banner blindness with native advertising
- [NPI Targeting](https://tapnative.com/NPI-Targeting.html): NPI targeting specifications using National Provider Identifier data for HCP precision
- [Revolutionizing Healthcare Recruitment With 1:1 Digital Engagement Targeting – Tap Native](https://tapnative.com/Revolutionizing-Healthcare-Recruitment-With-Digital-Engagement-Targeting.html): Healthcare recruitment via 1:1 digital engagement targeting on medical websites

## Healthcare Organization Solutions
